name: Display
author: "JB"

provenance.from: AMOSTools/Extensions, out of aminet dev/amos/amostools.i386-aros.lha -- held in the corpus at sources/aminet-dev-amos/. Its author's README says the directory is "every AMOS extension I can find, cut down to just their token tables with the make_extensions.pl script", and names the ExoticA AMOS extensions wiki page as the list it works from.
provenance.redistribution: Not redistributed here as software: the file carries no code at all. It is a token table with the library stripped out from under it, kept for identification and detokenising.
provenance.note: ExoticA's AMOS extensions list places it at slot 24. Nothing here observes it in a program: the slot is the wiki's recommendation and no more.

notes: TABLE ONLY. This is an AMOSTools stub -- the hunk shell and the token table survive, both length fields read zero, there is no code, and every entry's two routine words are overwritten with `====`. So the NAMES, the parameter SPECS and, because an id is the byte offset of its entry, the IDS are the original library's; the behaviour is not here and the evidence tier cannot rise above `manual` until a real binary turns up. The reader is checked against CRAFT and MusiCRAFT, which are held both ways, and agrees with them entry for entry -- see parseAmosToolsTable in src/tokens/libtok.ts. Six keywords, the smallest table in the registry after Personnal EXTRA's two: `dlcopswap`, `=dlscreenbase`, `=dldepth`, `=dlcheckaga`, `dlmergedisplay` (seven arguments) and `dlscreenoffset`. A copper-list and display-merging helper with an AGA test, at version 0.01 and by an author the wiki records only as "JB". Nothing else is known about it and the table is all there is.
